note: Tuning set. Every threshold is chosen here and only here. MOT17 base scenes 02, 04, 05, 11, 13 (FRCNN copy only). Own val clips must come from a different camera position AND recording session than any own test clip. Condition tags for MOT17 come from the official MOTChallenge sequence descriptions and are to be confirmed by looking at the frames. Entries ending in -5fps are frame-rate-matched copies of the same val scenes at about 5 fps (PLAN.md A6.3), added 2026-10-17.
